name: Monster Magnet
source:
Michelle Conner is finally moving out of her parents' house and into her own apartment in Premier City! It's been a while since she's met so many new people, so she's willing to overlook some of their more odd behaviors (them being cute does make it easier). Between her neighbor, her local barista, her classmate, her boss, and even the ghost haunting her new place, it's hard for her to choose a favorite. Luckily, she may not have to.

In Monster Magnet, you play as Michelle Conner as she meets 5 potential love interests and goes down 1 of 10 story routes, where she learns 2 of their secrets (something about her seems to attract people who aren't quite human). Play through their individual and intertwined stories, develop a bond with both love interests, and watch them develop bonds with each other. Confess your feelings at the Christmas Eve Festival, and hopefully you'll all walk away with a new partner or 2.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654900/Monster_Magnet/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
米歇尔·康纳 (Michelle Conner) 终于搬出了父母的房子，搬进了自己位于Premier City的公寓！她已经有一段时间没有认识这么多新朋友了，所以她愿意忽略他们的一些更奇怪的行为（他们很可爱确实让事情变得更容易）。在她的邻居、她当地的咖啡师、她的同学、她的老板，甚至是出没在她新地方的鬼魂之间，她很难选择一个最喜欢的。幸运的是，她可能不必这样做。

在《Monster Magnet》中，你扮演米歇尔·康纳 (Michelle Conner)，她遇到了5个潜在的恋爱对象，并沿着10条故事路线中的1条走下去，在那里她了解到了他们的2个秘密（她身上的某些东西似乎能吸引那些不太像人类的人）。体验他们各自的、相互交织的故事，与双方的爱情兴趣建立联系，并观看他们彼此建立联系。在平安夜表达你的感受，希望你们都能带着一两个新的伴侣离开。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654900/Monster_Magnet/]Steam[/url]]
